detail.description:
The ultimate Seotda, the true feel of HanGame Seotda, brought straight to mobile!

Experience the essence of Seotda in Mobile HanGame Seotda with the tension of big hands, meticulous battles of wits, and thrilling gameplay.

■ Now, enjoy Matgo in Seotda!

A thrilling showdown, Matgo Mode officially launched!

Feel the true thrill of Matgo!

■ GUCC Certified! A game certified under the Game User Protection Act.

■ The moment we unite with "Ttaeng," a massive "Ttaeng Pot" explodes! (New)
